vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: convert
Version: 2.0.2

The skill bundle is a documentation reference tool that provides static text information about a 'convert' utility. The bash script (scripts/script.sh) only uses heredocs to output plain-text documentation and contains no network calls, file system modifications, or credential access, aligning perfectly with the descriptions in SKILL.md.

llm.summary: The skill's files and runtime instructions match its description: it's a read-only reference/printing tool with no network, credential, or install requirements.

dimensions.detail: The name/description promise plain-text reference outputs. The included SKILL.md and scripts/script.sh implement only local heredoc text output of documentation and a simple CLI dispatch—no credentials, cloud APIs, or unrelated capabilities are requested.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: Runtime instructions and the shell script only print predefined documentation strings and respond to a small set of commands. The script does not read environment variables, inspect system files, make network calls, or transmit data to external endpoints. (Minor note: show_help uses a single-quoted heredoc so the $VERSION token won't expand as intended; this is a functional bug, not a security issue.)
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: There is no install specification; this is effectively instruction-only plus a bundled shell script. Nothing is downloaded or extracted from external URLs, and no package manager activity is declared.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill declares no required environment variables, credentials, or config paths, and the script does not access secrets or external service tokens. The level of environment access requested is minimal and appropriate for a documentation/reference tool.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: always is false (normal), the skill does not attempt to modify agent/system configuration, and it does not request persistent presence or elevated privileges.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill appears coherent and low-risk: it only prints bundled reference documentation and does not require credentials or network access. Before installing, you may (1) quickly review the included script to confirm it matches the packaged content (done here), (2) test it in a sandboxed agent run if you want extra caution, and (3) be aware of a harmless formatting bug (the help text won't show the version due to a quoted heredoc). If you need the skill to access external docs in the future, expect that would require explicit network/credential changes which should be re-evaluated.
